proposed_change: Permit one new, separately identified P1-S1 attempt set after a prior attempt was blocked by an external provider failure and independent provider recovery evidence is available, preserving all prior attempts immutably and keeping application_retry_count at zero.
experimental_problem_addressed: The P1-S1 smoke stage cannot reach candidate verification when an external provider failure blocks all prior attempts; without a distinct-attempt rule, provider recovery cannot be evaluated without either abandoning the frozen smoke cell or misclassifying a new attempt as an application retry.
smallest_sufficient_change: Add a prospective rule for at most one new attempt set only after independent availability evidence, immutable preservation of r1/r2, fresh IDs, and zero application retry; do not authorize execution or create IDs in this wave.
consequence_if_not_done: The blocked smoke stage remains incomplete even after an independently demonstrated provider recovery, and the protocol cannot distinguish a permitted new attempt from an application retry.
unchanged: r1 and r2 evidence remain immutable
no task payload is used for availability checking
no r3 IDs are created in this wave
all prior resource accounting remains retained
